description: This Java source file defines the MessageHeadersBuilder class, which provides a fluent API for constructing immutable MessageHeaders objects used in messaging within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for setting mandatory headers, optional headers, validators, and so on.

classes.name: MessageHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for constructing an immutable MessageHeaders object, facilitating the setting of headers such as direction, thing ID, subject, timestamp, status code, and optional feature ID.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder instance with mandatory headers, with overloaded variants accepting different input types, including deprecated CharSequence thingId and initial headers map or json object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeadersBuilder from a given header map or MessageHeaders object, validating the presence of mandatory headers.

methods.name: featureId
methods.description: Sets the feature ID associated with the message.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME content type for the message payload.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the message using an OffsetDateTime or ISO8601 string.

methods.name: statusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code associated with the message.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header, with checks to prevent removal of mandatory headers.
